parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the interface. This parameter is based on ''ifAdminStatus'' from {{bibref|RFC2863}}.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The current operational state of the interface (see {{bibref|TR-181i2|Section 4.2.2}}). {{enum}} When {{param|Enable}} is {{false}} then {{param}} SHOULD normally be {{enum|Down}} (or {{enum|NotPresent}} or {{enum|Error}} if there is a fault condition on the interface). When {{param|Enable}} is changed to {{true}} then {{param}} SHOULD change to {{enum|Up}} if and only if the interface is able to transmit and receive network traffic; it SHOULD change to {{enum|Dormant}} if and only if the interface is operable but is waiting for external actions before it can transmit and receive network traffic (and subsequently change to {{enum|Up}} if still operable when the expected actions have completed); it SHOULD change to {{enum|LowerLayerDown}} if and only if the interface is prevented from entering the {{enum|Up}} state because one or more of the interfaces beneath it is down; it SHOULD remain in the {{enum|Error}} state if there is an error or other fault condition detected on the interface; it SHOULD remain in the {{enum|NotPresent}} state if the interface has missing (typically hardware) components; it SHOULD change to {{enum|Unknown}} if the state of the interface can not be determined for some reason. This parameter is based on ''ifOperStatus'' from {{bibref|RFC2863}}.

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.description: {{datatype|expand}}

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The textual name of the interface as assigned by the CPE.

parameters.name: LastChange
parameters.description: The accumulated time in {{units}} since the interface entered its current operational state.

parameters.name: LowerLayers
parameters.description: {{list}} {{reference|an interface object that is stacked immediately below this interface object}} See {{bibref|TR-181i2|Section 4.2.1}}.

parameters.name: ConnectionStatus
parameters.description: Current status of the connection.

parameters.name: LastConnectionError
parameters.description: The cause of failure for the last connection setup attempt.

parameters.name: AutoDisconnectTime
parameters.description: The time in {{units}} since the establishment of the connection after which connection termination is automatically initiated by the CPE. This occurs irrespective of whether the connection is being used or not. A value of 0 (zero) indicates that the connection is not to be shut down automatically.

parameters.name: IdleDisconnectTime
parameters.description: The time in {{units}} that if the connection remains idle, the CPE automatically terminates the connection. A value of 0 (zero) indicates that the connection is not to be shut down automatically.

parameters.name: WarnDisconnectDelay
parameters.description: Time in {{units}} the {{param|ConnectionStatus}} remains in the {{enum|PendingDisconnect|ConnectionStatus}} state before transitioning to disconnecting state to drop the connection.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: Username to be used for authentication.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: Password to be used for authentication.

parameters.name: EncryptionProtocol
parameters.description: Describes the PPP encryption protocol.

parameters.name: CompressionProtocol
parameters.description: Describes the PPP compression protocol.

parameters.name: AuthenticationProtocol
parameters.description: Describes the PPP authentication protocol.

parameters.name: MaxMRUSize
parameters.description: The maximum allowed size of frames sent from the remote peer.

parameters.name: CurrentMRUSize
parameters.description: The current MRU in use over this connection.

parameters.name: ConnectionTrigger
parameters.description: Trigger used to establish the PPP connection. {{enum}} Note that the reason for a PPP connection becoming disconnected to begin with might be either external to the CPE, such as termination by the BRAS or momentary disconnection of the physical interface, or internal to the CPE, such as use of the {{param|IdleDisconnectTime}} and/or {{param|AutoDisconnectTime}} parameters in this object.

parameters.name: LCPEcho
parameters.description: A PPP LCP Echo Request is sent every {{param}} {{units}}. A value 0 means that no LCP Echo Requests are sent. {{bibref|RFC1661|5.8 Echo-Request and Echo-Reply}} describes the relevant LCP Echo frames.

parameters.name: LCPEchoRetry
parameters.description: Applicable only when {{param|LCPEcho}} is greater than 0. When number of consecutive {{param}} LCP Echo Replies have been missed. The remote peer will be assumed dead and the connection will be terminated.

parameters.name: LCPEchoAdaptive
parameters.description: When traffic is received during the {{param|LCPEcho}} interval, no LCP Echo-Request is sent until the next {{param|LCPEcho}} interval.

parameters.name: IPCPEnable
parameters.description: Enables or disables IPCP ({{bibref|RFC1332}}) on this interface. If this parameter is present, {{enum|IPCP|#.SupportedNCPs}} MUST be included in {{param|#.SupportedNCPs}}.

parameters.name: IPv6CPEnable
parameters.description: Enables or disables IPv6CP ({{bibref|RFC5072}}) on this interface. If this parameter is present, {{enum|IPv6CP|#.SupportedNCPs}} MUST be included in {{param|#.SupportedNCPs}}.

object.description: PPP interface table (a stackable interface object as described in {{bibref|TR-181i2|Section 4.2}}).
